title: DCML Label Payload
description: Harmony labels in the DCML harmony annotation standard, derived from ms3's DCML_DOUBLE_REGEX (https://github.com/johentsch/ms3, GPL v3: GNU General Public License version 3). The pattern is generated from experiments/dcml.py, with the numeral-run grouping tightened to avoid catastrophic backtracking, so unlike ms3 it rejects slash-free numeral run-ons such as "IIIIII[II". It is a syntax filter, not a well-formedness check: degenerate labels such as bare separators (e.g. "-", "|PAC", "{") are accepted, as is the empty string, since every part of the reference expression is optional.

value.description: DCML harmony labels, optionally including an alternative after a hyphen. Empty strings are valid labels.
